title: WKAppBot On-Load Checklist: session start and post-compaction
title_ko: 세션 시작 필수 체크리스트: gg 워크플로우 트리거
desc: Mandatory entry point for every session start, post-compaction, gg/ggg trigger, and handoff resume. Loads suggest-workflow ask-suggest-priority-batching claude-md-guide. Dispatches suggest backlog to Opus agent. Routes gg trigger to project CLAUDE.md gg Main Workflow section. Guides creation of missing gg section for new repos. Run this first on every fresh Claude session new chat wake-up after context compaction or when unsure what to do next.
steps: WHEN TO RUN THIS SKILL: (A) session start or post-compaction -> run steps 1+2. (B) user sends exactly 'gg'/'ggg' (English) or the Korean jamo equivalents (same keys in Korean mode) -> run step 3. (C) user says 'handoff' or 'continue from last session' -> run step 5. (D) user is mid-task or sent a casual greeting -> do NOT run the full pipeline. This skill is an entry-point router, not an always-execute checklist.

MANDATORY SKILL LOADS (session start / post-compaction only): run both -- (1) wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow (2) wkappbot skill read ask-suggest-priority-batching. Also read on first session: wkappbot skill read claude-md-guide -- explains global vs project CLAUDE.md roles and self-healing rules. If any skill fails: skip that step, report which skill failed, and ask the user to check wkappbot health.

CHECK SUGGEST BACKLOG (session start / post-compaction only): wkappbot suggest list. Priority: BUG-AUTO(crash/data-loss/blocking) -> important(user-visible bug, regression) -> AI-NEWS dupes(merge). Triage command -- substitute the actual suggest list output into the prompt before dispatching: Agent(model:'opus', prompt:'First run: wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow. Then triage this backlog: <INSERT suggest list output here>. Handle BUG-AUTO first, then important, then merge AI-NEWS duplicates via wkappbot suggest merge.'). Fatal = command not found / auth failure. Non-fatal = empty list / network timeout / partial output. Continue on non-fatal; report summary when done.

GG TRIGGER: if user message is exactly 'gg'/'ggg' (English) or the Korean jamo equivalents (same keys in Korean mode), locate section named either '## gg Main Workflow' or '## Main Workflow' in project CLAUDE.md and execute every step sequentially without confirmation. Continue on non-fatal step failures; report summary at end. If CLAUDE.md is missing OR has no gg section: stop here and follow step 6 to create it BEFORE executing. Do not re-invoke on-load from within the new section (circular reference).

COMPACTION RECOVERY (only after context compaction, not every session start): for full context re-hydration, also run: wkappbot skill read post-compaction-recovery. Skip this step on normal session starts.
HANDOFF: if user says 'handoff' or asks to continue from last session, run: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff -- then follow its steps to find the previous JSONL and extract context.

PROJECT MAIN TASKS -- gg section authoring (run only when step 4 cannot find a gg section): ask the user what the main recurring tasks are, then write '## gg Main Workflow' together in the repo CLAUDE.md. Rules: each step must be an executable shell command or Agent() call -- no vague descriptions. Include a Frequently used skills table (rank/Skill-ID/When). TEMPLATE: ## gg Main Workflow (MANDATORY when user sends gg) -- Execute in order: (1) wkappbot skill read on-load (2) wkappbot suggest list (3) Agent(model:opus, prompt:'run wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow first, then triage: <INSERT suggest list output> BUG-AUTO->important->AI-NEWS merge') (4) wkappbot speak 'triage done' --bg. Skills table: rank1/suggest-workflow/every session, rank2/ask-suggest-priority-batching/every triage.
